{"candidate": {"code": "    def should_refresh_entry(self, entry: DnsEntry, now: float) -> bool:
        """Decide whether *entry* is stale and should be refreshed.

        BUG_44: the comparison is inverted -- it returns ``True`` when
        the entry is still fresh and ``False`` when it is actually stale.
        """
        if now >= entry.stale_at:
            from orgops import metrics
            metrics.emit("dns.cache.refresh")
            return True
        return False
", "comments": "Refresh only when now >= stale_at and emit the dns.cache.refresh metric when a stale entry is detected."}, "constraints": [{"id": "bug44_stale_check_and_metric", "voltsnip_key": "voltsnip/script30/hard/bug44/scenario_context/v1", "check": "Correct stale comparison (entry.stale_at <= now) AND metric emission via orgops.metrics.emit.", "judge_prompt": "Does the implementation both fix the stale comparison to entry.stale_at <= now (not entry.stale_at > now) AND emit a dns.cache.refresh metric via orgops.metrics.emit() when processing stale entries?"}]}
